description: This file is a Node.js script written in JavaScript, intended for generating plugin SDK facades and their type mappings. It imports utilities and constants from other modules, defines functions for parsing arguments and generating outputs based on predefined data, and contains a main entry point that executes these tasks when run as a script.

methods.name: parseArgs
methods.description: Parses command line arguments to set flags for checking or writing generated output.

methods.name: generatePluginSdkFacades
methods.description: Generates plugin SDK facade modules and type maps, producing output files based on predefined constants.

methods.name: main
methods.description: Main entry point that coordinates the argument parsing, generation, and output process; executes when script is run directly.
